age_at_test.Description: Participant age at time of testing

EnglishPrimary_1_OrSecondary_2_.Description: Whether English is participant's primary or secondary language

cigarettesPerDay.Description: Average number of cigarettes smoked per day

MHDiagnoses.Description: Mental health diagnoses reported by participant (The options for the mental health diagnoses are as follows (multiple choices are allowed): Depression, Bipolar Affective Disorder, Gen. Anxiety Disorder, Panic Disorder, Antisocial Person Dis., Borderline Pers. Dis., Obsessive Compulsive Dis., Tourette Syndrome, ADHD, Charcot Marie Tooth Dis., Other(list)

AgeOfInitialDx.Description: Age at first mental health diagnosis

NeurologicalDiagnoses.Description: Neurological diagnoses reported by participant (The options for the neurological diagnoses are as follows (multiple choices are allowed): Epilepsy, MS, Parkinson's, Stroke, Head Trauma, Cerebral palsy, Other (list)

HighestYearOfSchool.Description: The highest year of school that the participant has completed (GED=12 years).

occupation.Description: Participant occupation. The labels are 1: professional, 2: intermediate (managers, teachers, etc.), 3: skilled, manual/non-manual (word processor, computer operator, electrician), 4: partly skilled (receptionist, cab driver), 5: unskilled (food service, machine operator), 6: student

Employment.Description: The usual employment pattern of the participants within the last three years. The labels are: 1: full time, 2: part time, regular hours, 3: part time, irregular hours, 4: student, 5: service, 6: retired/disability, 7: unemployed, 8: in a residential setting (hospital, jail, rehab center, etc.), 9: other (specify)

Handedness_LQ.Description: Laterality Quotient score from handedness inventory
